_shift_notes_S77e_step4: Classification (i) FIXTURE-WAS-WRONG — hand-written scenario had old-schema values the current builder cannot produce. Corrections: (1) purchaseType 'Direct Sale' → 'direct_from_builder' — old 'Direct Sale' has no exact V2 equivalent; resale_normal is blocked because its PropertyStage flagKey forces RTM which contradicts UC; direct_from_builder is the only UC-compatible V2 purchaseType; (2) propertyType 'Flat' REMOVED (no V2 binding — constructionStatus 'Flat' is now derived from constructionType answer on propertyCharacter); (3) constructionStatus 'Under Construction' → 'Flat' (builder maps constructionType Flat/House/Floor answer → constructionStatus; 'Under Construction' was a PropertyStage value); (4) propertyStage 'Superstructure' → 'Under Construction' (valid V2 PropertyStage option; 'Superstructure' was an older constructionProgress value on an orphaned question); (5) carpetArea/carpetAreaUnit/carpetAreaRaw added from propertyCharacter page; (6) titleChainStatus 'PENDING' REMOVED — titleChainStatus requires purchaseType='resale' and is HIDDEN for direct_from_builder; (7) encumbranceCertStatus 'CLEAR' REMOVED — same gate as titleChainStatus; (8) sellerTransaction fields NOT added — the entire sellerTransaction_homeLoan page is HIDDEN for direct_from_builder (requires resale); (9) ocCcAvailable NOT added — ocCcAvailable requires PropertyStage='Ready To Move', HIDDEN for UC; (10) municipalTaxStatus/unauthorizedAdditions/revenueRecordMutation/documentationReadiness added (OLD_MUNICIPAL surfaces these); (11) assessmentStatus/auctionPropertyStatus/registryTimeline added from their respective pages; (12) obligation shape — 'Credit Card' is NOT in CREDIT_LINE_TYPES (only CC Limit/OD Limit/Dropline OD auto-qualify); journey passes obligationType: 'credit_line' explicitly; cleanObligationEntries defaults (totalLimit/remainingLimit/utilizedAmount as '0' strings, empty tenure/interestRate strings for credit_line) included.
